name: teach
description: Understand what you built, how it works, and every technical word it uses.

interface.longDescription: Teach explains what you built and traces how it works in a private interactive HTML page, with visualizations, Kindle-style jargon tooltips, a complete dictionary, follow-up prompts, and a short quiz.
interface.defaultPrompt: Explain what I built in this chat, show how it works end to end, and define every technical term in an interactive local page.
